import { 
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial, 
  PlaneGeometry, 
  Mesh, 
  Group 
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep, texture } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new Group();

  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: "#16161d",
    paper: "#e8ecf2",
    accent: "#ff2a38",
    surface: "#0b0b10"
  };

  const cSurface = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063); // #0b0b10
  const cInk = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);    // #16161d
  const cAccent = vec3(1.0, 0.165, 0.22);    // #ff2a38

  // 1. STAGE (Backdrop with engineered gradient to avoid Flat Void)
  const bgGeo = new PlaneGeometry(8, 7);
  
  // Custom TSL colorNode for gradient backdrop containing an accent glow hint
  const bgUv = uv();
  const gradNode = mix(cSurface, cInk, bgUv.y);
  const glowNode = smoothstep(0.3, 1.0, bgUv.y).mul(smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, bgUv.x));
  const finalBgColor = gradNode.add(cAccent.mul(glowNode.mul(0.15)));

  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    depthWrite: false,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });
  bgMat.colorNode = finalBgColor;

  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeo, bgMat);
  bgMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(bgMesh);

  // 2. Sprite Setup (Atlas aspect ratio: 512 / 320 = 1.6)
  const width = 2.4;
  const height = width / 1.6;

  const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  const material = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0,
    depthWrite: true
  });

  const mesh = new Mesh(geometry, material);
  group.add(mesh);

  // Load and apply texture safely
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.imageUrl;
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      material.colorNode = texture(tex);
      material.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn("Failed loading Sprite texture:", err);
    });
  }

  // 3. Motion Weight (Entrance GSAP animation)
  mesh.position.y = -0.3;
  const entranceTl = gsap.timeline();
  
  entranceTl.to(mesh.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: "power3.out"
  });
  
  entranceTl.to(material, {
    opacity: 1,
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: "power2.out"
  }, 0);

  // 4. STRICT CLEANUP COMPLIANCE
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: function() {
      // Kill timelines
      if (entranceTl) {
        entranceTl.kill();
      }
      
      // Dispose Geometries
      if (bgGeo) bgGeo.dispose();
      if (geometry) geometry.dispose();
      
      // Dispose Materials
      if (bgMat) bgMat.dispose();
      if (material) material.dispose();
    }
  };

  return group;
}
